short_caption: Wood door, figure shelves, film poster, and corner desk.
literal_description: View of the wall containing the room door. A wood-veneer door with a metal lever handle is on the left, with a white light switch to its right. Two black floating shelves hold vinyl collectible figures and an orange-haired anime figure, beside a film poster with a pale face and blue sky. The desk sits in the right corner with a laptop, monitor, headphones, gamepads, and a glowing mouse; a gray step platform is under it. An office chair with a white frame and a black keyboard bench stand at the lower left, and a navy bed edge crosses the lower right. The floor is beige ceramic tile.
environment: Small residential bedroom, roughly 3 m by 3 m, with white painted plaster walls, beige square ceramic floor tiles with a matching tile skirting strip, an aluminum-framed casement window with a white roller shutter, and a wood-veneer interior door.
lighting: Even overhead artificial ceiling light, neutral white color temperature, low contrast, soft short shadows under furniture; no direct sunlight through the window.
atmosphere: Clear indoor air with no visible fog, smoke, dust, or haze.
ambient_sound: Quiet small-room tone with the low hum of a mini fridge compressor and a soft computer fan whir.

objects.name: ergonomic office chair
objects.description: Swivel office chair with a black mesh backrest and seat, adjustable black headrest, white plastic frame with looped white armrests and black padded armrest tops, a retractable footrest under the seat, and a white five-star base with black caster wheels.

objects.name: x-frame keyboard bench
objects.description: Folding X-frame bench with a square black padded vinyl seat, black tubular steel legs, and black rubber foot caps.

objects.name: floating wall shelf
objects.description: Thin black metal L-profile floating wall shelf about 40 cm wide.

objects.name: collectible vinyl figure
objects.description: Small stylized vinyl collectible figure with an oversized head and a small body, painted in character colors, about 10 cm tall.

objects.name: anime figure statue
objects.description: Anime character statue with spiky orange-red hair and a purple and white outfit, standing in a dynamic pose on a sculpted base.

objects.name: laminate computer desk
objects.description: Rectangular desk with a light gray-beige wood laminate top, a full-height laminate side panel on the right end, a front modesty panel, and one cylindrical brushed metal leg on the left end.

objects.name: black gaming laptop
objects.description: Black laptop with the lid open, a dark screen, and a red-backlit keyboard deck.

objects.name: curved computer monitor
objects.description: Black curved widescreen computer monitor on a black stand with a flat rectangular base.

objects.name: over-ear headphones
objects.description: Black over-ear headphones with blue accents on the ear cups and a padded headband.

objects.name: white and black wireless gamepad
objects.description: Wireless game controller with curved white outer grips, a black center face, two analog sticks, face buttons, and a central touchpad.

objects.name: rgb gaming mouse
objects.description: Black computer mouse with blue and white RGB light strips on the top shell.

objects.name: aerobic step platform
objects.description: Rectangular gray plastic aerobic step platform with a textured top and magenta-pink riser blocks under both ends.

objects.name: single bed
objects.description: Single bed with a thick mattress in a navy blue fitted cover, resting on a light gray upholstered base with rounded ends and short chrome cylindrical legs.
